verdict.rationale: The API uses a versioned base path (POST https://api.beglaubigt.de/v1/trade-registration), so URL-level versioning is evidenced. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, changelog, sunset timelines or version lifecycle, and no OpenAPI spec could be found. Missing for 10: documented deprecation/sunset policy, changelog or version-migration guidance, published versioned API spec, independent corroboration.
